description: Implementation of a Software Defined Radio (SDR) controller class for managing radio sectors, timing, and frequency adjustments in a wireless communication system.

classes.name: ru_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Main controller class managing SDR timing, sectors, and frequency settings.

classes.name: ru_gain_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Handles transmission and reception gain settings.

classes.name: ru_cfo_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Manages CFO (Carrier Frequency Offset) adjustments for sectors.

classes.name: ru_center_frequency_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Controls setting of transmit and receive center frequencies for sectors.

classes.name: ru_tx_time_offset_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Sets transmission time offsets for sectors.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts radio streaming at a specified or calculated time, aligning with 1PPS if start_time is provided.

methods.name: set_lower_phy_sectors
methods.description: Assigns a list of lower PHY sectors and initializes controllers.

methods.name: set_tx_gain
methods.description: Sets transmit gain for a given port.

methods.name: set_rx_gain
methods.description: Sets receive gain for a given port.

methods.name: set_tx_cfo
methods.description: Schedules CFO adjustment for a sector.

methods.name: set_rx_cfo
methods.description: Schedules CFO adjustment for a sector.

methods.name: set_tx_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets transmit center frequency for a sector.

methods.name: set_rx_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets receive center frequency for a sector.

methods.name: set_tx_time_offset
methods.description: Sets transmission time offset for a sector.
